title: Approved Artifact Read — Request
description: Provider-neutral request envelope for the `artifact.approved.serve_http` capability. The capability accepts only a domain lookup request (a source_id and an artifact_id) and never carries API keys, headers, IP addresses, endpoint URLs, or other transport or authentication details. The identifier formats mirror the existing rules in `src/server/api-server.ts`: `source_id` matches `^[a-z0-9_-]+$`; `artifact_id` matches `^artifact--[a-z0-9_-]+--[a-z0-9_-]+$`. The output is a `classifier-approved-artifact-export`; the read request must not duplicate that payload.

source_id.description: Source identifier. Must match the existing API server source_id pattern.

artifact_id.description: Artifact identifier. Must match the existing API server artifact_id pattern.
